Weremantis Guard (Human Form) CR 4

Dressed in strangely disjointed chain mail over flowing, oddly-cut robes, the woman warrior demands your respect without saying a word. The magic sigil or holy symbol hanging from her neck is simple but unfamiliar.

XP 1,200
Human kavbroed (natural) weremantis cleric 1/fighter 3
LE Medium humanoid (human, shapechanger)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+6 armor)
hp 36 (1d8+3d10+12)
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +6; +1 vs. fear

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee shortspear +5 (1d6+1), dagger +4 (1d4+1)
Ranged shortspear +4 (1d6+1), dagger +3 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks channel positive energy 5/day (DC 12, 1d6)
Domain Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st; concentration +4)

6/day—moment of insight, touch of evil

Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 1st; concentration +4)

1st—ant haul, detect undead, protection from good D
0 (at will)—detect magic, detect poison, virtue

D domain spell; Domains Destiny, Evil

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 10, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 12
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 14
Feats Alertness, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness, Weapon Focus (shortspear)
Skills Diplomacy +5, Heal +9, Intimidate +4, Knowledge (religion) +4, Sense Motive +9, Survival +6
Languages Common
SQ change shape (human, hybrid, and giant mantis; polymorph), inhuman appearance, lycanthropic empathy (mantids and giant mantids)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Moment of Insight (Sp)

A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier you gain a +2 insight bonus to any attack roll, ability check, skill check, or saving throw.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forest
Organization solitary
Gear chain mail, shortspears (4), dagger, silver holy symbol

The average female weremantis in humanoid form is tall and thin, although they can come from just about any humanoid stock. They wear clothing tailored to allow transformation into hybrid form without restriction of movement or shredding of fabric. Most are armed with a dagger, the sacred weapon of their goddess, as well as whatever other weapon(s) they’re comfortable with.
